title: Validation rehearsal
text: Rehearsal applies item-declared migrations only to the separately bound validation database and records durable control-plane receipts. The disposable validation copy is the named restore point through apply, invariants and verification commands, including nested history applies. Rehearsal writes no backup archive and records an empty migration_audit.backup_path; to reset, rerun authority_validation_copy and the governed rehearsal. Attested commands run after each module with its exact identifier in reserved YOKE_MIGRATION_REHEARSAL_MODULE, replacing inherited context; module-specific commands validate it before using the copy, while fleet callbacks run after complete convergence. A selected source worker must be an active registered lane of the named item, authorized by the caller's matching item or task claim. Invalid source bindings refuse with rehearsal_source_lane_invalid and recovery; without a binding the ordinary item-lane default wins over cwd. A source lane re-enters as yoke dev run -- yoke --env <name> migration rehearse ITEM; --env placed before dev run is refused with use_https_env. A DB claim's rehearsal_commands are test commands; listing the rehearse command there makes rehearsal call itself and fail.
